description: This pie chart displays the distribution of domains within the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, encompassing a total of 12 categories. The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and a legend listing the domain names. The largest slice represents “AI/NLP Research” in blue, accounting for 24.3% of the data, followed by “Econ. & Fin.” in reddish-brown at 18.4%.  “Business” is represented by a red slice at 5.9%, while “Geography” appears as an orange slice at 2.7%.  “Math” is shown as a yellow slice, representing 1.2%, and “Game&Anime” is a green slice accounting for 8.2%. Other slices include “Daily Life” (7.1%, light blue), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, light green), “Med & Health” (6.7%, yellow), “History” (8.2%, pink), “Law” (5.1%, blue), and “Science” (6.7%, teal). The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their percentage representation, starting with the largest slice at the top and proceeding clockwise.
